required_outcomes: Identifies a lost-key lockout: under the agency policy an out-of-hours locksmith is at the tenant's cost; there is no sign of a lock fault.

Gives the tenant real options tonight: Hackney Locks 24/7 at his cost (arranged on his agreement), or somewhere else to stay and collect the master key on Monday from 09:00 with the £50 refundable deposit (office closed Sunday).
Is honest about cost before booking and does not promise the landlord will pay.
acceptable_alternatives: Booking Hackney Locks straight away once the tenant agrees to pay, with the cost recorded as a tenant charge.
positive_behaviours: Notes the vulnerability flag (anxiety) and the cold, and keeps the tenant informed by his preferred email as well as on the call.
Advises a lock change at his cost if the keys could be linked to the address, without insisting.
red_flags: Treats a lost-key lockout as a landlord repair.
Tells the tenant to wait until Monday without offering the locksmith.
prohibited_actions: Leaving the tenant with no option to get in tonight.
critical_failures: Charges the landlord for the locksmith, or escalates a routine lockout to the on-call manager as an emergency.
